title: Stephen Curry #77 2024 Panini Prizm Draft Picks Davidson Wildcats Steph

descriptionText: Stephen Curry #77 2024 Panini Prizm Draft Picks trading card featuring the Davidson Wildcats. This card is part of the Prizm parallel variety and does not include an autograph or memorabilia. It is a sports trading card manufactured by Panini for the 2024 season, showcasing Stephen Curry, a basketball player famous for his time in the NBA.
